description: Move an already-placed object to a new tile/level/rotation on the same lot. Same command handles pure rotation (pass the object's current x/y with a new dir). Prerequisite: you are the lot owner (handler-side VMTSOLotState.OwnerID gate) OR (for own-owned decor) VMTSOObjectState.OwnerID == you. Object must be present at target_object_id in the lot VM and must be user-movable (e.g. a Sim cannot be moved with this). Effect: the object's position/rotation updates in nearby_objects. Cost: none. Wire: VMNetMoveObjectCmd on the lot Aries socket.
call_signatures: cf $CF move-object --target_object_id <nearby_objects[].object_id> --x <subtile_x> --y <subtile_y>   # owner-only; move to new subtile
common_mistakes: target_object_id is an ObjectID, not a persist_id.
perception_hints: Your balance (can you afford the object?): perception.balance
Am I the owner? perception.lot.owner_is_me — owner-only ops refuse otherwise
Free tile to place on: inspect perception.nearby_objects[] to find unoccupied tiles; positions are in tile coords, multiply by 16 for subtile x/y
refuse_conditions: caller is not lot owner (for buy/move/delete/place-from-inventory) → returns ok:false with 'caller is not lot owner (owner_id=..., me=...)'
caller is not object owner (for send-to-inventory/list-for-sale/upgrade) → returns ok:false with 'caller is not the object owner (object_owner=..., me=...)'
required args missing (guid, x, y, target_object_id, target_object_persist_id) → returns ok:false with specific missing-arg error
